persona_named: Neha Kapoor (National MT & Quick-Commerce Supply Lead — Gurugram & Mumbai)

levers_inr_cr.zero_rationale: Operates within existing inventory pools (Flow = 0); directly blocks 5-10% retailer OTIF chargebacks (Risk) and prevents full-PO dock refusals & dark-store delistings (Revenue Recovery).
